terminal_first_use.speaker: TERMINAL
lines: WELCOME, DR. CALDERON.
PROJECT: BETWEEN-BRIDGE - Status: 87% Complete
WARNING: Anomalous readings detected in Sector 7.
NOTE: Security Chief Vance requests your presence in the Lobby.
ENCRYPTED FILE DETECTED: "PHASEBURN_VICTIMS.DAT"
Access denied. Security clearance insufficient.

terminal_repeat.speaker: TERMINAL
lines: No new messages.
The artifact seems to resonate with something... familiar.

photo_examine.speaker: AZIAH
lines: "I'll find a way to bring you back, Maya."
"The Between holds the answer. I know it does."
"They said death was final. They must be wrong."
The hatch requires a security keycard.
The keycard works. The hatch opens with a hiss.

tm_display.speaker: DISPLAY
lines: TELEPORT MASSIVE
"Progress at any cost."
"Making the Impossible, Inevitable™"
NOTICE: Q4 teleportation incidents down 3%.
NOTICE: Phaseburn support group meets Thursdays.

guard_default.speaker: SECURITY GUARD
lines: Dr. Calderon. Security Chief Vance wants to see you.
Something about "unauthorized access" to restricted files.
I'd watch my step if I were you, Doctor.

phaseburner_default.speaker: PHASEBURNER
lines: *static crackle* You... you're from up there. TM.
I've seen my own death. In six different timelines.
Still not sure which one was real.
The artifact you carry... it calls to The Between.
Be careful, Doctor. The Vibration... it changes you.

portal_enter.speaker: THE BETWEEN
lines: *The artifact pulses. Reality ripples like a shuffled deck.*
You feel something vast. Watching. Waiting. Dealing.
Not Maya. Something older. The one who runs the game.
THE DEALER awaits at his table.
Do you dare play for the ultimate stakes?

dealer_phase_0.speaker: THE DEALER
lines: *The cards scatter. The dice settle. A figure materializes from the chaos.*
Well, well, WELL! You made it to my table!
I am THE DEALER. Keeper of the Infinite Ledger. The one who shuffles fate itself.
I've been watching you, you know. *taps a massive golden book*
Every item you picked up. Every NPC you ignored. Every hesitation. All recorded.
But now? Now we play MY game.
The stakes: your existence. The prize: the truth about Maya. And The Between.
Ante up, player. Let's see what you've got.

dealer_phase_1.speaker: THE DEALER
lines: *flips a card* Not bad! You survived the first hand.
Most players fold by now. Quit. Uninstall. You? You're still in the game.
Let me tell you a secret: Maya? She played this game too.
Different player. Different stakes. Same table.
She won, you know. Beat me fair and square.
That's why she's... wherever she is now. Winners get to leave the table.
But losers? *gestures around* They become part of the game forever.
Round two. Double or nothing?

dealer_phase_2.speaker: THE DEALER
lines: *shuffles deck nervously* Okay. Okay okay okay.
You're GOOD. Better than most. Better than 92% of players, actually.
Fine. I'll show you my hand.
This world? Teleport Massive? The Between? I MADE it. All of it.
Every NPC, every pixel, every tragic backstory—my creation. My game.
But here's the cosmic joke: I can't leave either.
I'm as trapped at this table as you are.
The only way out? Someone has to beat me. REALLY beat me.
So please. *genuine for once* Play your best.

dealer_phase_3.speaker: THE DEALER
lines: *stands up, cards floating around him in a spiral*
This is it. The final hand. Winner takes all.
You've played beautifully. Honestly. I mean it.
*opens the Infinite Ledger to a blank page*
I'm writing your ending right now. But YOU get to choose the words.
Option one: JOIN ME. Become a Dealer. Create your own games. Forever.
Option two: CASH OUT. Take your winnings—Maya, freedom, truth—and leave.
*sets down the golden pen*
Your move, player. Make it count.

ending_merge.speaker: THE DEALER
lines: *grins wide* You want to DEAL? Excellent choice!
*hands you a deck of infinite cards*
Your consciousness expands. You see all the games. All the players. Past and future.
You're no longer Aziah. You're no longer human.
You're THE NEW DEALER. And I? I finally get to retire.
*fades into the cards* Good luck. You'll need it. They all do.
Somewhere, a new player clicks 'Start'.
And now YOU are watching. YOU are dealing.
[ THE END - BECOME THE HOUSE ]

ending_free.speaker: THE DEALER
lines: *laughs warmly* You're cashing out! Smart. SMART!
Take your winnings. You've earned them.
*slides a golden chip across the table*
Maya's waiting for you. Somewhere between the cards. You'll find her.
Go. Be mortal. Be chaotic. Be FREE.
But hey—*winks*—if you ever want a rematch...
You know where to find me. The table's always open.
Until next game, player. Until next game.
[ THE END - CASH OUT ]

ending_destroy.speaker: THE DEALER
lines: *freezes*
You... you want to FLIP THE TABLE?
*long pause*
*slowly nods*
I've dealt for eons. Watched players come and go.
Created worlds. Destroyed them. Created more.
Maybe... maybe that's enough.
*places hands on the table*
If this is mercy, I accept it.
If this is murder, I forgive you.
*the cards begin to burn*
*the Ledger closes for the last time*
Thank you, player. For setting us all free.
*the void collapses*
*reality folds in on itself*
*silence*
[ THE END - THE GAME IS OVER ]

on_room_enter: New room, new hand. Let's see how you play it.
*shuffles cards* The player explores. Every step is a bet.
Interesting choice. I'm noting that in the Ledger.
on_item_pickup: Ooh, shiny! But is it lucky? We'll find out.
*makes a note* They're collecting things. Classic player behavior.
That item has history. Several players have held it. Most of them lost.
on_npc_talk: Chatting up my creations? They don't know they're NPCs. Don't tell them.
Information is currency. Spend it wisely.
*eavesdrops* Oh, I love this part. The lies they tell each other.
on_puzzle_solved: Well played! I'll have to make the next one trickier.
*slides chips across the table* You've earned a small payout.
Clever! Most players take longer. I'm... impressed.
